signals.title: HackerTube: a 6,454-video curated site built from a community's links in two hours, cloned three times in 48 hours
signals.summary: Karpathy mined 40K HN comments into a YouTube-style site with Claude Code in ~2 hours, wrote no code. 2,693 HN points; HackerBooks (1,630 pts), Wikihack and HackerHack followed within two days. The corpus-to-curated-site loop is now an evening's work.
signals.run_with_it_note: Pull every question and place-name out of the NOLA brands' reviews and OpenCX sessions, have Claude Code build an 'answered by our guests' page set on admirenola.com in one evening, and watch GSC impressions and AI citations for 30 days.

signals.title: AI agents are now phoning local businesses; 1 in 25 already has its own agent answering
signals.summary: Voygr's agents made 848 calls to SF businesses in early October; 1 in 3 people stayed on the line after learning it was AI. Agents try to book but get stuck at payment. Same week Retell reports 100M agent calls a month (OpenAI, Oct 27).
signals.run_with_it_note: Put the OpenCX phone agent on the NPB main line after hours and on missed calls, with one rule: if the caller says it is an AI agent, give hours, all-in prices and the booking link, then log it. Count agent calls for two weeks.

signals.title: Google Connected Apps public preview opens to booking and ordering services in AI Mode and Gemini
signals.summary: Any developer can apply; apps connect via a remote MCP server, Google reviews and tests each one. US English only, 50+ apps live, Viator is the only travel app. Marie Haynes calls it a bigger opportunity than GEO.
signals.run_with_it_note: Stand up a read-only remote MCP server for one brand (NPB: availability by date, all-in price, booking link) on mbp-2 behind Tailscale Funnel, register it in the Google Connected Console, and apply to the waitlist. No booking writes until Google approves.

signals.title: Big brands dominate AI travel answers but lose on subjective and inspiration queries
signals.summary: BrightEdge: booking platforms appear in 78% of budget-related AI Overviews answers; booking-intent prompts are only 9% of the sample. First-hand, opinionated content and UGC get cited on inspiration queries.

signals.title: Google Search ad shows an Apple Messages button that opens an SMS to the advertiser
signals.summary: Seen on one iPhone in Philadelphia, Oct 28. Tapping drafted an SMS to the advertiser's number. Not announced by Google, not in the posting agency's own accounts; US isn't on the help page's country list for iOS message ads.

signals.title: Reddit will move to a logged-in-only experience after search referrals fell 1M a week
signals.summary: Q4 test outside the US first, then global. Huffman blames AI Overviews and AI Mode. Stock fell 33% on Nov 2. The biggest UGC source for AI answers is about to get harder to crawl.

signals.title: OccupySaaS: laid-off engineers rebuilding SaaS as open source with AI agents
signals.summary: 387 HN points. Clean-room, Apache-2.0 clones built by agents from public API docs: ZeroAuthy (Auth0-compatible), SalesCompel (Salesforce-compatible). Next targets include customer support.

signals.title: Mistral Large 4 open weights: 1T params, $0.70 per M input, ranked just behind Opus 5.5 in blind human evals
signals.summary: Modified-MIT license, commercial use allowed. API $0.70/$2.10 per M tokens. Another open-weight contender feeding last week's price-collapse spark.

signals.title: Microsoft Clarity: AI agents check out in 25% of their sessions and book appointments in 8%
signals.summary: 5.2M agentic sessions across 230K Clarity projects, Aug 13 to Sep 9. 'Book appointment' is in the agent top ten and not the human top ten. Clarity is already on David's sites.

signals.title: Shopify Fall '26: Shop Pay inside personal AI agents, stores run from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini
signals.summary: Checkout inside Muse, Claude Duet and Instinct; merchants manage inventory and orders from nine AI chat apps. Agent commerce plumbing is landing, but it's retail and David isn't on Shopify.

signals.title: Perplexity Computer runs fully local on Apple silicon Macs (36 GB+ RAM)
signals.summary: Model (Qwen 3.6 or PPLX Pro), agent and task execution all on the Mac, for Pro/Max subscribers. Hob (MIT, HN 177 pts, Oct 26) is the open-source version of the same idea. mbp-2 is Intel, so neither runs there.

signals.title: Claude Duet: Anthropic's beta personal-assistant harness with channels and per-channel access
signals.summary: 126 HN points. Fast replies while background work runs, channels that reference each other, no stored credentials. Beta, desktop only, no public availability or price stated. Shop Pay already works inside it.

signals.title: Instagram pays select creators $50K to $500K for long-form Features videos
signals.summary: Features allows 90-minute videos, limited US test. Deals are one-offs with big names per Business Insider; Meta confirms funding but not amounts.

signals.title: Anthropic files S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO as ANT
signals.summary: Shares and price range not set. Nate B Jones' read of the S-1: existing customers spent about 9x year over year. Context for the vendor the whole stack runs on, nothing to do.

signals.title: Seed stage this week: Pixel Systems $3.1M (Stockholm, AI-content detection); climate subwatch quiet a third week
signals.summary: Only one dated seed round surfaced. Climate: no October startup rounds found again; only a new $22.4M fund (Antares Ventures, Oct 21). Three empty weeks in a row for the subwatch.

signals.title: Wikipedia 'Seed money' article views jumped 7x from Oct 23 (faint, cause unknown)
signals.summary: 112 views/day through Oct 22, 612 to 783/day Oct 24-28, easing to 359 by Nov 1. No news hook found. Could be a class assignment or a link from somewhere popular.
